flaws.description: Removed the 'Medium' entry from the category_orders list for 'Farm Size Category', so px.strip no longer plots the Medium farm size series even though the underlying data, legend, and color sequence remain unchanged.

Replaced the qualitative Set2 palette reference with an explicit hex-color list that swaps the colors assigned to the 'Small' and 'Large' farm-size categories, so Small now renders in lavender and Large in teal instead of the summary's stated teal/lavender mapping.
